candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified fact and explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: Monthly BDUK contract figures are rounded management-information snapshots with ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current service availability, orderability or contractual milestone performance.
scope_guards.monthly_comparison: A January-to-July difference is arithmetic between rounded BDUK snapshots and may reflect scope changes, resubmissions or ingestion timing; it is not a parcel-level build claim or milestone assessment.
scope_guards.consumer_process: ADR, end-of-contract, contract-selection and fault-resolution guidance describes consumer processes and protections; it does not establish current network availability, speed or orderability at an exact address.
scope_guards.regulatory_scope: General Conditions describe regulatory obligations and categories; they do not prove parcel connectivity or current address-level service availability.
